mdcalc_source: https://www.mdcalc.com/calc/691/sequential-organ-failure-assessment-sofa-score (platelet, GCS, bilirubin, cardiovascular, renal bands fetched directly; the PaO2/FiO2 point table did not render in the fetch, so respiratory bands are the standard MDCalc/Vincent 1996 ones)
mdcalc_rules: Use worst value over 24 h. Resp PaO2/FiO2: >=400 0; 300-399 +1; 200-299 +2; <=199 and not mechanically ventilated (CPAP counts as ventilated) +2; 100-199 ventilated +3; <100 ventilated +4. Platelets x10^3/uL: >=150 0; 100-149 +1; 50-99 +2; 20-49 +3; <20 +4. GCS: 15 0; 13-14 +1; 10-12 +2; 6-9 +3; <6 +4. Bilirubin mg/dL (umol/L): <1.2 (<20) 0; 1.2-1.9 (20-32) +1; 2.0-5.9 (33-101) +2; 6.0-11.9 (102-204) +3; >=12 (>204) +4. CV (mcg/kg/min): no hypotension 0; MAP <70 +1; dopamine <=5 or any dobutamine +2; dopamine >5 or epi <=0.1 or norepi <=0.1 +3; dopamine >15 or epi >0.1 or norepi >0.1 +4. Renal creatinine mg/dL (umol/L): <1.2 (<110) 0; 1.2-1.9 (110-170) +1; 2.0-3.4 (171-299) +2; 3.5-4.9 (300-440) or UO <500 mL/day +3; >=5.0 (>440) or UO <200 mL/day +4.

code_vs_mdcalc.issue: No substantive scoring difference found. Respiratory, CV (pressor hierarchy evaluated before MAP; MAP=(SBP+2*DBP)/3 <70 -> 1; hypotension flag used only when BP absent), GCS, platelets, bilirubin and renal (max of creatinine and urine output) bands and boundaries match MDCalc. CPAP is treated the same as mechanical ventilation, as on MDCalc. Code reproduces all 20 stored answers from the stored inputs.

Minor: SI values are converted to mg/dL (creatinine MW 113.12, bilirubin MW 584.66) and scored on mg/dL cut-offs, whereas MDCalc prints rounded umol/L bands. Values in the gaps (creatinine 106-109, 171-176, 300-308 umol/L; bilirubin 20.5-20.9, 33-34 umol/L etc.) could score one point differently. No test row or the one-shot falls in a gap (creatinine 92.12, 120, 121.32, 130, 140, 150, 160 umol/L; bilirubin 88.41 umol/L).

Cosmetic: the not-ventilated <200 branch checks a misspelled key 'mechanical_ventillation'; because cpap/mechanical_ventilation are always defaulted beforehand, the logic still evaluates correctly. Vasopressor units are not checked (all inputs are mcg/kg/min).

items.details: Two issues. (1) Bilirubin unit: note says '1.57 mg/L' (= 0.157 mg/dL, 0 pts) but the stored input silently uses 1.57 mg/dL (1 pt); with jaundice and scleral icterus, mg/dL is clearly intended, so the note has a unit typo. (2) Urine output: 'no urine output recorded' reads as anuria (same wording style as the one-shot, which scores 0 mL/day -> 4 renal points) but could also mean 'not documented'; the inputs omit Urine Output, so renal = 0 from Cr 92.12 umol/L (1.04 mg/dL). Other components: CPAP, 90/0.41=219.5 -> 2; dopamine 6.32 (>5), norepi 0.1, epi 0.1 (<=0.1) -> 3; GCS 10 -> 2; plt 88.4k -> 2. Totals: stored reading 2+3+2+1+2+0=10; anuric reading 14; literal mg/L reading 13 (anuric) or 9. Recommend fixing note to 'mg/dL' and making urine output unambiguous (or adding Urine Output [0,'mL/day'] -> 14).
